package.description: Review Windows driver inventory and available update offers before changing your PC.

en-US.description: Review Windows driver inventory and available update offers before changing your PC.
en-US.longDescription: Tweaky Driver distinguishes detected devices, download-ready driver offers, and catalog candidates. Review each offer and its source before making changes. Driver discovery depends on compatible packages and supported sources; detection does not guarantee that an update is compatible or beneficial. Some packages are download-only.
